senses.gloss: סַקֵּיד (Saf. of נ־קד I; interch. with סקר, cmp. נקר I) to sting, goad; to drive, train.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 8:5">Targ. Y. Deut. VIII, 5</cite> (some ed. <he>מְסַקֵּר</he>; incorr. <he>מַסְקַר</he>; h. text <he>יסר</he>).—Pesik. Baḥod. p. 153ᵃ (ref. to <he>מלמדך</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 48:17">Is. XLVIII, 17</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="M01600"><he>מַלְמַד</he></cite>) [read:] <he>מְסַקֵּיד לך כמא דהדין מסאסא מסקיד להדא פרתא</he> who trains thee (through sufferings) as the goad trains the cow; [Ar. s. v. <he>מסקיד</he>: <he>מְסַקִּידְנָא וכ׳</he> I train thee &c.]; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29">Lev. R. s. 29</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 782">Yalk. Num. 782</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 645:2">Yalk. Lev. 645</cite> <he>מְסַקֵּר</he>.
